Authored grove appearance record

Captured from unchanged grove production code at 6b0a32e, Go 1.26.10.
486 samples: three times, nine eastings, six northings and three heights.
The retained public API producer is grove_sample.go. From the module root:
go run ./scene/medium/testdata/grove_sample.go

These samples preserve picked patch noise, advection and boundary fades.
They are not measured fog, water budgets or condensation predictions.
The analytic optical-depth, geometry and GPU checks remain independent.

find_mist_endpoints.go reproduces the strong noise peaks used by the exact
coverage endpoint check. It filters candidate hashes for speed, then checks
every result with the production noise.Fractal API. At (5016.5,5016.5,5016.5)
seed 6856140 gives 0.83929338789271224 and seed 36335586 gives
-0.85694944754429803. The test expects clear or half-height filled density,
not a copy of the patch-noise formula.
